findings.title: seededRandom('') ignores the provided empty-string seed and is non-deterministic
findings.property: two generators created with the same provided seed string produce identical sequences
findings.expected: Both generators yield the same sequence, since a seed string was provided (only an omitted seed should be random)
findings.actual: '' is falsy, so `str ? ... : Math.random()` picks a random seed and the sequences differ
findings.evidence: Docstring: 'When not provided, the seed is randomly generated'; param type is `str?: string`, and '' is a provided string. Every other string seed is deterministic; the check should be `str === undefined`.

review.title: seededRandom('') treats an empty-string seed as omitted and returns a non-deterministic generator
review.reason: The docstring says the seed is random only 'when not provided', and the parameter is typed `str?: string`. The check `str ? ... : Math.random()` is a truthiness test, so a provided '' is treated like undefined. Every other string seed gives a deterministic sequence, and `hashSeed: ''` passed through CronExpressionParser.parse silently loses reproducibility. A maintainer would probably accept a one-line `str === undefined` fix, but '' is an edge-case seed and nothing in the tests or README promises how it behaves, so severity is low.

fix.reason: the repro passes on the patched code
